title: If an AI Agent Cannot Read Your Presale, Your Project Does Not Exist
seoTitle: Can an AI Agent Read Your Presale Project?
description: Off-plan buyers will soon send AI agents to screen projects. Learn why one brochure and a few renderings will not be enough, and what agents need to see.
answer: Soon, investors and families will ask an AI agent to find off-plan property for them. The agent can only suggest projects it can read, screen and compare. A brochure, a few renderings and a price list that says call for pricing give it almost nothing. Projects that put every unit online, with real layouts, views and prices, will be found first.
body:
Picture an investor in Dubai buying ten units in a Miami presale tower without visiting a sales gallery or speaking to a broker. Their AI agent talks to the developer's AI agent, and the deal is done before lunch. In my view, this is not science fiction. It is where the market is heading.

## Who will screen your project first

Today, a developer markets to people. Tomorrow, the first visitor to your project will often be a machine. A buyer will tell their agent what they need: a budget, a location, a delivery date, a minimum yield, a developer with a solid track record. The agent then scans every project it can find. Your sales team, your gallery and your launch event are no longer the first contact.

## Why a brochure is invisible to an agent

Most presales are presented with one brochure, a few renderings of the best unit and a price list that says "call for pricing." For an agent, that is almost nothing. It cannot screen it and it cannot compare it, so it will not suggest it. Not because the project is bad, but because the agent has no evidence that it is good.

## What an agent needs to recommend you

The project that gets recommended is the one an agent can read and verify:

- Every unit online, not only the penthouse
- The real layout of each unit
- The real view from the real floor
- The real price

## The agent does the data, the family does the feeling

A home is still an emotional decision. A family will not buy just because an agent says so. But when the agent can open a unit in 3D, the family can walk through it, stand at the window and see their own kitchen before they see any other project. That unit wins.

Think of restaurants that were not on Google Maps ten years ago. They did not close in a day. They slowly stopped being found.

This short comes from a full episode on the three stages of AI agents in real estate. Listen at [/podcast/off-plan-buyers-will-send-ai-agents/](/podcast/off-plan-buyers-will-send-ai-agents/).
takeaways: Buyers will increasingly send an AI agent to find and screen off-plan projects for them.
An agent only recommends projects it can read, screen and compare.
One brochure, a few renderings and call for pricing give an agent almost nothing to work with.
Projects with every unit online, with real layouts, views and prices, get found first.
The agent handles the data, but the family still makes the emotional decision.
faq: Will AI agents buy real estate for people?
In my view, yes, starting with investors who buy on numbers like yield and exit. Families will follow, using agents to find homes while still making the final decision themselves.
What information does an AI agent need about a presale project?
It needs data it can compare: every unit, the real layout, the real view from each floor and the real price. A brochure and a few renderings are not enough.
Why would an AI agent ignore a good project?
Because it cannot recommend what it cannot read. If the information is missing or hidden behind call for pricing, the agent has no evidence the project fits the buyer.
